#!/bin/sh
set -u

PRIMARY_IF=enp8s0
PRIMARY_PEER=10.10.30.3
REMOTE_ENDPOINT=10.10.21.3/32
LOCAL_ENDPOINT=10.10.20.2
PRIMARY_METRIC=10
FAILURES=0
STATE=unknown

route_present() {
    ip -4 route show exact "$REMOTE_ENDPOINT" | grep -Fq "via $PRIMARY_PEER dev $PRIMARY_IF"
}

install_primary() {
    route_present && return 0
    ip -4 route add "$REMOTE_ENDPOINT" via "$PRIMARY_PEER" dev "$PRIMARY_IF" proto static metric "$PRIMARY_METRIC" src "$LOCAL_ENDPOINT"
}

withdraw_primary() {
    route_present || return 0
    ip -4 route del "$REMOTE_ENDPOINT" via "$PRIMARY_PEER" dev "$PRIMARY_IF" metric "$PRIMARY_METRIC"
}

trap 'withdraw_primary; exit 0' TERM INT

while :; do
    if ping -n -4 -I "$PRIMARY_IF" -c 1 -W 1 "$PRIMARY_PEER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        FAILURES=0
        if ! route_present; then
            if install_primary; then
                logger -t static-route-convergence "primary peer $PRIMARY_PEER reachable; preferred route installed"
            fi
        fi
        STATE=up
    else
        FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1))
        if [ "$FAILURES" -ge 2 ]; then
            if route_present; then
                withdraw_primary
                logger -t static-route-convergence "primary peer $PRIMARY_PEER unreachable; preferred route withdrawn"
            fi
            STATE=down
        fi
    fi
    sleep 1
done
